# Janice Chen | Realtor® — Pinnacle Real Estate Group

> Janice Chen (DRE# 02140656) is a bilingual (English / Mandarin / Taiwanese) full-service real estate consultant serving the San Gabriel Valley and Inland Empire corridor of Southern California, including Walnut, Diamond Bar, Rowland Heights, Eastvale, Chino, Chino Hills, Ontario, and Arcadia. She specializes in new construction, 1031 exchanges, probate real estate, and investment advisory for local Chinese-speaking buyers/sellers and overseas Taiwanese investors.
